title: Thoughts on my UI???
author: JustANerd420
selftext:
I am creating an app that will help in making pixel art for video games. I got the inspiration to work on it again seeing someone else post their application like the one I had planned before. Long story short, I couldn't find the UI elements I wanted so I had been working with Nano Banana 2 and my Zed IDE (Gemma 4 31B model) to create some javascript files for my app. 

What do you think about the overall quality? The palette boards have selection, can you see the difference between an unselected and a selected square? What do you think about the tooltip and the color picker box?

comments.author: TheKaleKing
comments.body:
Love the art style! It doesn't look like AI which is great.

Can you share a bit how did you make this with AI? My AIs aren't that great

replies.author: JustANerd420
replies.body: Sure! So to start off I grabbed a reference image from [UIverse.io](http://UIverse.io) and feed that into [Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com/) using the Nano Banana 2 "Redesign" feature. I would describe what I wanted to change and how it should look. Once I got all the UI elements I needed, I went into my AI IDE and fed it each image, told it to create me a pixel-perfect copy of the image into JavaScript file, then I would have it rig up any functions I can think of at the time. Once I have 12 more of these things complete, I will go to my main app and just move over the .jsx files and work with AI to have it implement them one by one.

replies.author: JustANerd420
replies.body: Oh, forgot to mention one step, when I am redesigning with Nano, I also reference one of the other images I already had it create, so that it helped keep the style the same.

comments.author: DashLego
comments.body: Too old school for my taste, but great job, keep up the good work

replies.author: JustANerd420
replies.body: Thanks! I know it looks old, but that is for reasons of what the app is going to do. I might try and develop a few themes, if I have the time, and maybe have something look more modern.
